messages:
Rae (Design): Quick poll: for the Pools bulk-delete UX, do we prefer per-row inline errors or a single summarized error panel after submit? trying to minimize visual noise but keep things keyboard-friendly. Priya (PM): Summary panel + anchors. Users doing bulk ops want one place to scan failures. :thumbsup: Diego (Eng): Agree on summary + anchors. Implementation note: move focus to summary after submit and provide skip links. Jae (DevEx): Also suggest showing inline collapsed details for the first 2 errors so people can see context without jumping around. Keep them collapsible. Rae (Design): Good point. For screen readers, should we auto-expand the first one when landing on the summary? a11y-bot: Recommended: set focus to a role="status" container with aria-live="polite" announcing the number of failures. Links in the summary should have aria-controls to reveal per-row regions. Example:
2 items failed
. Priya (PM): New question: typed-confirm for destructive deletes vs checkbox + strong warning. Thoughts? Diego (Eng): Typed-confirm reduces accidents but adds time. If we do it, auto-focus the input, allow paste, exact-match after trimming whitespace, and disable the confirm CTA until it matches. Use autocomplete=off. Jae (DevEx): Prefer disabling CTA until match + visible validation message. Ensure focus doesn't get trapped and that keyboard users can cancel easily. Rae (Design): Copy tweak suggestion: instead of 'Type the pool name to confirm' -> 'Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool.' stronger tone. a11y-bot: Also recommend aria-invalid on mismatch and aria-describedby pointing to helper text. Provide clear error string like 'Names do not match.' Priya (PM): Proposal: hybrid error surface (top summary with anchors + expandable inline details for first 2 fails). Typed-confirm enabled only for org-owned or large pools; otherwise use checkbox+warning. Diego (Eng): Sounds good. I'll add focus-handling tickets and exact validation rules. Jae (DevEx): I'll add keyboard acceptance criteria to the PR checklist. Rae (Design): I'll post a compact mock for the summary + inline previews and the confirm modal copy. Tagging @Diego @Jae @Priya for quick review. Priya (PM): thanks — will update the spec and rollout notes.
